verdict.rationale: The NVIDIA H200 is a data-center GPU, a hardware product, so a data-training opt-out control is a category error for it. Confidential Computing support is a related hardware security feature, not a control over whether a vendor trains on user data. Nothing in the pack shows the GPU itself ships such a control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
